transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As we prepare for next week's mediation, I need us to take a careful look at the facts on the table. The former sales manager is claiming unpaid commissions, retaliation, and reputational harm, and has demanded $70,000. I have authority to approve the company's final resolution package, but before I set our settlement range and strategy, I want to make sure we're not missing anything. As part of our standard pre-mediation review, I'm asking payroll counsel and employee relations to report any facts that should affect our proposed resolution. What do you each have for me?
